mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when the rate trend is downward.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and declines in unemployment rate signal an overheating economy triggering aggressive monetary tightening, which depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts above 2000 thousand units signal expanding residential construction demand that boosts consumer spending and corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days during housing market expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 2000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index above 115.0 indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 115.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Falling housing starts below 2000 thousand units signal housing sector contraction that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 2000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Robust payroll growth exceeding 100 thousand persons signals strong labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days during strong labor market regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in CPI inflation and federal funds rate signal aggressive monetary policy response to inflation, which reduces real economic growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
